dimensions.note: The extension holds no credentials and reads no vault. requester, loggedBy and transfer_ownership store people's names and emails, as the people list already did. export_snapshot still writes emails to a new 0600 file only. revise_specification and record_build_result fetch only https URLs, and refuse http.

Every change method logs through change() with the request number, id, status and version, including the new revise_specification and transfer_ownership. record_build_result logs why a published build isn't released, which now includes missing router evidence. No spec content, reasons or emails beyond the acting person are logged.

Capture's refusals are DomainErrors in plain words with a code. New ones: a stale basedOnVersion, an outcome spec for another request, a blank reason, an unknown requester (refused before anything is created), a transfer by a non-owner or of a closed request. A refused revise_specification leaves the request unsaved, because the whole revise, edit and propose runs before mutate saves (tested). Malformed JSON text in specification is a SyntaxError from the argument preprocess, as edit_specification already was.

66 test files' suites pass (270 steps), with deno check, lint and fmt clean, and CI green on main e10dd69. New: effects schema, hash and keep-on-edit; revise_specification from agreed and discussing, stale, mismatched id, observer, not-ready rollback and the agreed export carrying changeSummary; requester ownership, idempotency, unknown requester and transfer; Released with and without router evidence, wrong version, two recipes and a recipe built for another request; the per-section diff including effects. The page was checked rendered. The real swamp CLI was not run for these methods; tests use FakeSwamp.

create_request's key is still the logging person plus sourceRef, so a retry with requester returns the same request; the owner is not changed on a repeat. Recording the same build result twice changes nothing. revise_specification is not idempotent by design: a second run with the same basedOnVersion is refused as stale, so it can't propose twice.

outcome-spec/v1 gains two optional fields, specification.effects and specification.changeSummary, which the v1 header allows; the Factory's reader ignores unknown fields (checked). build-result/v1 examples gain optional recipeId and router, agreed with the Factory and merged there (factory#116); Capture's contract test parses the Factory's main example. capture-log-request gains an optional requester with a blank default, so existing callers are unchanged.
No new handles, timers or subprocesses. readJsonInput reads one file or one https response and closes it. The viewer page is rendered on the server from swamp data, as on main.

Shipped files: README.md, LICENSE, manifest.yaml, capture.ts, capture_web.ts, _lib and both workflows. The README examples use example.com addresses and relative paths only. The manifest description is updated for revise_specification, transfer_ownership, effects, requester and the Released rule.

EffectsSchema refines kind against changes (write needs at least one, read none). requester accepts only blank or an email. The router outcome is an enum. Reader schemas for build-result/v1 drop unknown fields, as before.
No new resource specs. request stays infinite with garbageCollection 50.
Requests gain a way to change their outcome owner (transfer_ownership) and to revise and propose in one step. Nothing deletes a request; withdraw, decline and duplicate close it, as before.

Every change checks the acting person's role and the request's status before it writes. revise_specification checks the editSpecification permission and basedOnVersion before revising. create_request resolves the requester in the people list before numbering or saving.
No new instance names: request-<id>, outcome-spec-<id> and the others are unchanged. revise_specification writes only request-<id>.

The requests behavior reads only its own data through the store. The viewer reads one requests behavior's data with swamp's data query. No data.latest across apps; Capture still imports nothing from the Factory (independence_test).

Both behaviors go from 2026.11.09.1 to 2026.11.09.2 with a no-op upgrades entry that keeps global arguments; capture_test checks the last entry matches the model version and the manifest. Stored requests need no migration: loggedBy, changeSummary, effects, recipeId and router are all optional, so requests saved before read as they did. A request already Released keeps its status; the new rule applies to results recorded after.
